text: I think you'll really enjoy this Banana Spice Bars recipe! It features shortening, which is a key ingredient you've shown a fondness for in the past. The combination of sugar, eggs, and bananas will likely appeal to your sweet tooth, and the addition of cinnamon, clove, and allspice will add a warm, comforting flavor. The recipe is also relatively quick to make, taking about 45 minutes, which is right in line with the average time you've allocated to your cooking projects. Give it a try!
